channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.title: Garanhuns (PE) Supplies & equipment procurement · signed contract #2026NE000097
item.description: A public buyer in Garanhuns (PE) has signed a contract for supplies, equipment or consumables, awarded to Atomos Comercial LTDA, with a contract value of about R$ 29,210; signed Jun 19, 2026, in force until Dec 31, 2026. It is a closed deal rather than an open tender; see the official PNCP contract page for the full text and performance details.
